newsitem.title: USA: Southwestern Public FY96 shr declines.
newsitem.headline: Southwestern Public FY96 shr declines.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
Full company name is Southwestern Public Service Co
NOTE: The company said earnings in fiscal 1995 had been enhanced by one-time adjustments totalling $0.24 per share.

The company also said the sale by its Quixx Corp subsidiary of water rights in the Texas Panhandle resulted in an after-gain of $7.7 million or $0.19 per share in 1996. It said fiscal 1996 earnings declined to due to non-recurring expenses and increased operating expenses, including merger-related expenses of about $5.7 million and business integration expenses o $2.2 million. This reduced earnings by $0.17 per share, it said.
